fusions.name: Pointing the Quarry
fusions.desc: You jab a dart of force from the staff's tip at the first enemy within 6 tiles, dealing 4 damage with a 30% chance to leave it [Marked] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Run to Ground
fusions.desc: You lunge the full length of the staff at an enemy within 4 tiles at or below 30% health, dealing 24 damage, up to 1.3 times that at full reach.

fusions.name: Halloo the Pack
fusions.desc: You raise the staff to signal the chase: every ally within 5 tiles deals 15% more damage for 10 seconds and fights with 1 more power.

fusions.name: Closing In
fusions.desc: Your damage rises by 12% against enemies below 50% health, once the staff has run them down that far.
